name: North Yarmouth Academy Summer Programs
description_short: Weekly day camps on the North Yarmouth Academy campus in Yarmouth, Maine, for ages 2 to 16. Each week offers many separate programs, from toddler camps and general day camp to sports, arts, Lego, robotics, circus arts, farm and outdoor adventure camps, several run by partner groups.
refund_policy_summary: The $50 deposit per session is never refunded. Full refund less deposit for cancellations 21 or more days before the start, 50 percent less deposit after that, and none within seven days. Partner camps are not refunded after June 1.
special_needs_notes: Campers of differing abilities are welcome, but staff ratios do not allow constant one on one support; call the Director of Summer Programs to plan. Toddler campers ages 2 to 3 need not be potty trained.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Page says its information is from the 2026 season and 2027 details come in February. Weekly sessions June 15 to August 7, 2026, no camps in Clam Festival week (July 13 to 17) except hockey, which ran through August 14. Early bird discount $25 by April 15. Prices are per program and not on this page.

warnings: No prices: each program has its own fee in the registration system.
Many separate programs run each week on the same campus; kept as one listing because they share the campus and weekly sessions.
